# testdata — Unit Test Dataset Documentation

The CSV files in this directory are generated by `dataset/main.py --export` from the [NAB (Numenta Anomaly Benchmark)](https://github.com/numenta/NAB) dataset, for Go / Rust backend unit tests.

---

## File Naming Rules

```
{period}_{label}[_{role}]_{short_id}.csv
```

| Segment | Values | Semantics |
|----|------|------|
| `period` | `p24h` / `p7d` / `p24h7d` / `pnone` | Main period detected by autocorrelation |
| `label`  | `anom` / `clean` | Whether it contains anomaly labels (rows with is_anomaly=1) |
| `role`   | `hist` / `curr` (optional) | split mode: history segment / current segment; omitted means the full series |
| `short_id` | shortened original file name | distinguishes files of the same kind |

---

## CSV Field Documentation

| Field | Type | Description |
|------|------|------|
| `timestamp_ms` | int64 | Unix millisecond timestamp (used by real* categories) |
| `timestamp_s`  | int64 | Unix second timestamp (used by artificial* categories) |
| `value`        | float64 | Metric value |
| `is_anomaly`   | int (0/1) | 0 = normal, 1 = anomaly |

> `timestamp_ms` maps directly to `rsod_core::ad::RawPoint.timestamp_ms: i64`.

---

## Labeling Modes

| Mode | Parameter | Semantics |
|------|------|------|
| **window** (default) | `--label-mode window` | All points inside the anomaly time ranges in `combined_windows.json` are marked 1 |
| **point** | `--label-mode point` | Only the exact timestamps in `combined_labels.json` are marked 1 |

---

## Periodicity Overview

Datasets are selected by period strength (autocorrelation coefficient ACF), covering the two typical periods 24h and 7d:

| File prefix (dir/) | Interval | ACF 24h | ACF 7d | Period type | Has anomalies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `artificialNoAnomaly/p24h_clean_art_daily_no_noise` | 5 min | **1.0** | **1.0** | 24h (pure sine baseline) | No |
| `artificialNoAnomaly/p24h_clean_art_daily_small_noise` | 5 min | **0.99** | **0.99** | 24h (noisy baseline) | No |
| `artificialWithAnomaly/p24h_anom_art_daily_*` | 5 min | 0.86–0.93 | 0.87–0.94 | 24h | Yes |
| `realAWSCloudwatch/p24h_{}_rds_cc0c53` | 5 min | **0.71** | –0.30 | **24h** | Yes |
| `realAWSCloudwatch/p24h_{}_rds_e47b3b` | 5 min | **0.68** | –0.38 | **24h** | Yes |
| `realAWSCloudwatch/p24h_{}_ec2_53ea38` | 5 min | **0.62** | 0.56 | **24h** | Yes |
| `realAdExchange/p24h7d_{}_exchange2_cpm` | 60 min | **0.82** | **0.69** | **24h + 7d** | Yes |
| `realAdExchange/p24h7d_{}_exchange2_cpc` | 60 min | **0.82** | **0.60** | **24h + 7d** | Yes |
| `realKnownCause/p24h7d_{}_asg_cpu` | 5 min | **0.77** | **0.64** | **24h + 7d** | Yes |
| `realKnownCause/p7d_{}_nyc_taxi` | 30 min | **0.80** | **0.92** | **7d (strongest)** | Yes |

## Per-Dataset Details

### artificialNoAnomaly (pure periodic baseline)

Sampling interval: 5 minutes, time range: 2014-04-01 ~ 2014-04-14, 4032 rows total, ACF 24h = 1.0.  
Labeling mode: `window` (`timestamp_s`), is_anomaly all 0.

| File | Value range | Purpose |
|------|------|------|
| `p24h_clean_art_daily_no_noise.csv` | [10, 90] | Perfect 24h sine, no noise, establishes the period-detection baseline |
| `p24h_clean_art_daily_small_noise.csv` | [8, 92] | 24h sine + small Gaussian noise, tests noise robustness |

**Suitable test scenarios**: verifying the detector produces no false positives on pure periodic signals.

---

### artificialWithAnomaly (synthetic)

Sampling interval: 5 minutes, time range: 2014-04-01 ~ 2014-04-14, 4032 rows total, ACF 24h ≈ 0.86–0.93.  
Labeling mode: `point` (`timestamp_s`).

| File | Anomaly pattern | Exact anomaly timestamp | Anomaly window | Value range |
|------|----------|----------------|----------|------|
| `p24h_anom_art_daily_flatmiddle.csv` | mid-section values zeroed (flatline) | 2014-04-11 00:00:00 | 2014-04-10 07:15 ~ 2014-04-11 16:45 | [-22, 88] |
| `p24h_anom_art_daily_jumpsdown.csv`  | sudden value drop | 2014-04-11 09:00:00 | 2014-04-10 16:15 ~ 2014-04-12 01:45 | [18, 88] |
| `p24h_anom_art_daily_jumpsup.csv`    | sudden value jump | 2014-04-11 09:00:00 | 2014-04-10 16:15 ~ 2014-04-12 01:45 | [18, 165] |
| `p24h_anom_art_daily_nojump.csv`     | baseline drift without jumps | 2014-04-11 09:00:00 | 2014-04-10 16:15 ~ 2014-04-12 01:45 | [18, 88] |
| `p24h_anom_art_increase_spike_density.csv` | increased spike density | 2014-04-07 23:10:00 | 2014-04-07 06:25 ~ 2014-04-08 15:55 | [0, 20] |
| `p24h_anom_art_load_balancer_spikes.csv` | periodic load balancer spikes | 2014-04-11 04:35:00 | 2014-04-10 11:50 ~ 2014-04-11 21:20 | [0, 3.23] |

**Suitable test scenarios**: anomaly type identification, boundary detection (flatmiddle / jump), sparse anomaly detection.

### realAdExchange (ad exchange platform, 1h interval)

Sampling interval: 60 minutes, labeling mode: `window` (`timestamp_ms`).  
**24h + 7d dual period** (ACF 24h ≈ 0.82, ACF 7d ≈ 0.60–0.69).

| File | Rows | Time range | Anomaly rows |
|------|------|----------|----------|
| `p24h7d_clean_hist_exchange2_cpc.csv` | 76  | 2011-07-01 ~ 2011-07-04 | 0   |
| `p24h7d_anom_curr_exchange2_cpc.csv`  | 499 | 2011-07-04 ~ 2011-07-24 | 163 |
| `p24h7d_clean_hist_exchange2_cpm.csv` | 397 | 2011-07-01 ~ 2011-07-17 | 0   |
| `p24h7d_anom_curr_exchange2_cpm.csv`  | 786 | 2011-07-17 ~ 2011-08-19 | 162 |

`cpc` anomaly window: 2011-07-11 04:00 ~ 2011-07-17 22:00  
`cpm` anomaly window 1 (0th): 2011-07-24 14:00 ~ 2011-07-27 22:00  

**Suitable test scenarios**: detector performance on 1h-granularity, dual-period (business traffic) data.

### realKnownCause (real known-cause anomalies)

Labeling mode: `window` (`timestamp_ms`).

#### `p24h7d_*_asg_cpu` — **24h + 7d dual period**, ACF 24h=0.77, ACF 7d=0.64

Sampling interval: 5 minutes, 62 days, CPU anomaly caused by ASG misconfiguration.

| File | Rows | Time range | Anomaly rows |
|------|------|----------|----------|
| `p24h7d_clean_hist_asg_cpu.csv` | 14535 | 2014-05-14 ~ 2014-07-03 | 0    |
| `p24h7d_anom_curr_asg_cpu.csv`  | 3515  | 2014-07-03 ~ 2014-07-15 | 1499 |

Anomaly window: 2014-07-10 12:29 ~ 2014-07-15 17:19  
**Suitable test scenarios**: detector on long dual-period series with ample history (50-day baseline); 7d weekday/weekend pattern verification.

#### `p7d_*_nyc_taxi` — **strongest 7d period**, ACF 7d=0.92, ACF 24h=0.80

Sampling interval: 30 minutes, NYC taxi ridership. Takes the 0th anomaly window (Halloween peak).

| File | Rows | Time range | Anomaly rows |
|------|------|----------|----------|
| `p7d_clean_hist_nyc_taxi.csv` | 5639 | 2014-07-01 ~ 2014-10-26 | 0   |
| `p7d_anom_curr_nyc_taxi.csv`  | 607  | 2014-10-26 ~ 2014-11-08 | 207 |

Anomaly window (Halloween): 2014-10-30 15:30 ~ 2014-11-03 22:30  
**Suitable test scenarios**: strong 7d-period signal + holiday anomalies; verifying model ability to recognize periodic traffic anomalies.

## Usage Examples

### Rust (rsod-ad unit tests)

```rust
use rsod_utils::read_csv_to_vec;
use rsod_core::ad::{MinimalAdRequest, RawPoint};

fn load_raw_points(path: &str) -> Vec<RawPoint> {
    // CSV format: timestamp_ms,value,is_anomaly
    let data: Vec<[f64; 3]> = read_csv_to_vec(path);
    data.iter().map(|r| RawPoint {
        timestamp_ms: r[0] as i64,
        value: r[1],
    }).collect()
}

#[test]
fn test_detect_periodic_24h() {
    // p24h — rds_cc0c53: ACF 24h=0.71, strong 24h period
    let history = load_raw_points("../../dataset/testdata/realAWSCloudwatch/p24h_clean_hist_rds_cc0c53.csv");
    let current = load_raw_points("../../dataset/testdata/realAWSCloudwatch/p24h_anom_curr_rds_cc0c53.csv");
    let req = MinimalAdRequest { history, current, ..Default::default() };
    let resp = rsod_ad::detect::detect_online(req).unwrap();
    assert!(resp.points.iter().any(|p| p.is_anomaly));
}

#[test]
fn test_detect_periodic_7d() {
    // p7d — nyc_taxi: ACF 7d=0.92, strongest 7d period
    let history = load_raw_points("../../dataset/testdata/realKnownCause/p7d_clean_hist_nyc_taxi.csv");
    let current = load_raw_points("../../dataset/testdata/realKnownCause/p7d_anom_curr_nyc_taxi.csv");
    let req = MinimalAdRequest { history, current, ..Default::default() };
    let resp = rsod_ad::detect::detect_online(req).unwrap();
    assert!(resp.points.iter().any(|p| p.is_anomaly));
}

#[test]
fn test_no_false_alarm_on_clean_periodic() {
    // p24h clean — perfect 24h sine, expect no false alarms (is_anomaly all 0)
    let data = load_raw_points("../../dataset/testdata/artificialNoAnomaly/p24h_clean_art_daily_no_noise.csv");
    // ... build history + current, expect all resp.points is_anomaly == false
}
```

```go
// Read CSV to build a data.Frame, then call rsod.MiniAdDetect(currentFrame, historyFrame, opts)

```

## Regenerating Data

The export command generates CSVs with the NAB original file names; after generation you must manually `mv`-rename them.

```bash
cd dataset

# Clean baseline (24h period)
python main.py --export \
  --categories artificialNoAnomaly \
  --files art_daily_no_noise,art_daily_small_noise \
  --timestamp-unit s
# Rename: add the p24h_clean_ prefix

# Synthetic anomaly series (24h period)
python main.py --export \
  --categories artificialWithAnomaly \
  --label-mode point --timestamp-unit s
# Rename: add the p24h_anom_ prefix

# Real AWS data with 24h period (split)
python main.py --export \
  --categories realAWSCloudwatch \
  --files ec2_cpu_utilization_53ea38,rds_cpu_utilization_cc0c53,rds_cpu_utilization_e47b3b \
  --split --split-current-rows 576 --window-index 0 --timestamp-unit ms
# Rename: ec2_cpu_utilization_53ea38_history → p24h_clean_hist_ec2_53ea38, and so on

# ec2_cpu_utilization_24ae8d (full + split)
python main.py --export \
  --categories realAWSCloudwatch \
  --files ec2_cpu_utilization_24ae8d \
  --timestamp-unit ms
python main.py --export \
  --categories realAWSCloudwatch \
  --files ec2_cpu_utilization_24ae8d \
  --split --split-current-rows 300 --timestamp-unit ms

# 24h+7d dual period (ad exchange)
python main.py --export \
  --categories realAdExchange \
  --files exchange-2_cpm_results,exchange-2_cpc_results \
  --split --split-current-rows 336 --window-index 0 --timestamp-unit ms

# 24h+7d dual period (ASG CPU)
python main.py --export \
  --categories realKnownCause \
  --files cpu_utilization_asg_misconfiguration \
  --split --split-current-rows 4032 --timestamp-unit ms

# Strongest 7d period (NYC Taxi)
python main.py --export \
  --categories realKnownCause \
  --files nyc_taxi \
  --split --split-current-rows 400 --window-index 0 --timestamp-unit ms
```

See `python main.py --export --help` for more options.
